reponse: No internal salary band for the Austin Support Engineer role appears in these results: the job description and the H2 2026 hiring plan both just say "see the comp sheet" [1][5]. Northpeak's recruiter asked Carla for the band on 16 November because candidates were asking upfront [4], and no answer shows up here. The only figure is an external market estimate for a Tier 2 fintech support engineer in Austin with 3–5 years' experience, roughly $75,000–$95,000 base, which explicitly is not the company's band [2]. The approved band in the results is for a senior SRE in Tel Aviv, a different role [3].
